module: Editor camera API. initialize(editorInstance) installs on the editor object the camera type constants (CameraType_Game = 1, CameraType_Free = 2), the speed constants (CameraSpeed_Slowest 5, Slow 35, Slower 70, Normal 100, Faster 130, Fast 165, Fastest 200), the currentCameraType / previousCameraType state and the functions for the free camera, camera bookmarks (stored in MissionGroup/CameraBookmarks) and "smooth" camera parameters (newton). The functions listed are therefore methods of editor, not of the module.
usage:
editor.toggleFreeCamera()
local id = editor.addCameraBookmark("bridge view")
editor.jumpToCameraBookmark(id)
notes: selectCamera does nothing until the level is loaded (global variable levelLoaded).
The smooth zoom (fitViewToSelectionSmooth) runs in a job of 21 steps of 50 ms; the view radius is clamped between 20 and 16000.

Inconsistency: fitViewToSelection tests editor.selection.objects (plural) whereas the other functions test editor.selection.object (singular); the test on the plural is therefore always true for "no object" and uses the gizmo.
getCameraSpeed(speed) ignores its argument and returns core_camera.getSpeed().
setSmoothCameraMove / Rotate only act in free camera; the "normalized" drag values are converted to the 5-20 range (1 = 5, 0 = 20).
isFreeCamera is a local function that is not exported.

initialize.desc: Called by the editor: installs the camera constants and functions on the editor instance.

editor.desc: Methods added to the editor instance by this module.

selectCamera.desc: Chooses the view's camera: game (commands.setGameCamera) or free (commands.setFreeCamera); remembers the previous type.

toggleFreeCamera.desc: Toggles between the current game camera and the editor's free camera.

cameraLookAtPoint.desc: Orients the camera toward a point in the world.

placeCameraAtSelection.desc: Places the camera at the centroid of the object selection (no effect if nothing is selected).

placeCameraAtPlayer.desc: Places the camera at the player's position (commands.dropCameraAtPlayer).

placePlayerAtCamera.desc: Places the player's vehicle at the camera's position (position only).

fitViewToSelection.desc: Places the camera 15 m behind the center of the selection (or of the gizmo) keeping its starting orientation then turns it toward the center.

center.desc: Center to aim at; by default the center of the selection box.

fitViewToSelectionSmooth.desc: Like fitViewToSelection but with an animated approach and a distance adapted to the selection's size.

addCameraBookmark.desc: Adds a named camera bookmark at the free camera's current position, in MissionGroup/CameraBookmarks (group created if needed).

getCameraBookmarks.desc: Returns the SimGroup containing the bookmarks (creates it if needed; nil without MissionGroup).

jumpToCameraBookmark.desc: Moves the camera to a bookmark's position and rotation.

copyCameraBookmarkToClipboard.desc: Copies to the clipboard a bookmark's position and rotation as text [x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw].

pasteCameraBookmarkFromClipboard.desc: Applies to the free camera the transform text read from the clipboard (commands.setFreeCameraTransformJson).

getObjectLocationText.desc: Returns an object's position and rotation as text [x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw] (internal editor use).

setSmoothCameraMove.desc: Enables or sets the free camera's "newton" translation (inertia).

setSmoothCameraRotate.desc: Enables or sets the free camera's "newton" rotation.

setSmoothCameraDrag.desc: Sets the free camera's translation drag.

setSmoothCameraAngularDrag.desc: Sets the free camera's angular drag.

setSmoothCameraDragNormalized.desc: Sets the drag from a 0-1 value (1 gives 5, 0 gives 20).

setSmoothCameraAngularDragNormalized.desc: Sets the angular drag from a 0-1 value (same scale).

getSmoothCameraParams.desc: Returns the smooth free camera's parameters.

returns.desc: {newtonMode, newtonRotation, mass, drag, force, angularDrag, angularForce}, or nil (warning) if the free camera does not exist.

setSmoothCameraParams.desc: Applies smooth free camera parameters and resets the angular velocity to zero.

params.desc: {newtonMode, newtonRotation, drag, mass, force, angularDrag, angularForce}.
